content:
Maya S: Short sync for the webinar launch post + landing. Need a tight SEO preflight: 3 primary keywords, JSON-LD payloads, quick internal link touches, redirect CSV, and CRM routing. Live target next Tue.

Ravi K: Ok. Propose primaries + longtails and meta desc for the landing. Keep titles under 60 chars.

Maya S: Primaries: "LLM inference platform", "production LLM serving", "dedicated inference clusters". Longtails: inference cost optimization, KV cache, continuous batching, model rollouts.

Tara L: I'll drop minimal JSON-LD for Event + FAQ. Snippet for head: 
```
<script type=\"application/ld+json\">{\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"Event\",\"name\":\"Redwood Inference webinar: Serving LLMs in Prod\",\"startDate\":\"2024-06-18T17:00:00Z\",\"url\":\"https://redwood.inference/events/serving-llms\"}</script>
```
I'll follow with 3 FAQ Q/A from the deck.

Devon P: Redirect CSV template I'll run night of publish (301). Example: 
```
source,target,code
/old-webinar,/events/serving-llms,301
/blog/2023/llm-inference,/events/serving-llms,301
/docs/inference,/events/serving-llms,301
```

Ravi K: Internal linking: add CTA links from /docs/runtime and /product/features. Anchors: "low-latency serving", "reduce inference cost". I'll open PRs.

Maya S: CRM webhook must include utm params + webinar_id. Routing rule: company_size > 50 -> SDR; else -> nurture. Field: interested_in for sku. @Devon confirm keys.

Devon P: Confirmed payload: email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size (int), utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id, interested_in. 200 OK on success.

Tara L: Two hero variants for signup modal: A) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency" B) "Cut inference cost while keeping SLAs". 50/50 for first 1k impressions; measure CTR & conversion.

Maya S: Timeline: blog draft Fri, landing Mon, redirect sweep Mon night. Owners: Tara (schema/copy), Devon (redirects/webhook), Ravi (links), Maya (PM).

SEO-bot: Task created: MARKETING-6201 "webinar landing SEO sweep" (https://trello.company/board/card/MARKETING-6201).

Maya S: I'll post the draft link here when ready. Any blockers?

Ravi K: All clear from Eng. :thumbsup:
